component.name: Project KONGOR V (WILLOWMAKER)
component.summary: Unofficial Community Game Client Launcher & Modernization Runtime for Heroes of Newerth

description.p: WILLOWMAKER is an independent, unofficial open-source desktop game launcher and client modernization runtime for Heroes of Newerth on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck (unaffiliated with Garena, S2 Games, Frostburn Studios, or Kongor Studios).

ul.li: Bring-Your-Own-Assets (BYOA) setup for Heroes of Newerth on modern Linux and Steam Deck (SteamOS)
Automatic compatibility layer for legacy K2 engine Linux dependencies (GTK2, GConf, libudev0)
Differential CDN delta patching with SHA-256 and CRC32 integrity verification
Wayland, XWayland, and high-refresh display support
Integration with self-hosted and community Project KONGOR V servers

description.p: Project KONGOR V v5.0.2 War Effort quests and 14-bag reward track, matchmaking fix, seamless Queue Arcade bot/player swaps, custom map stats, match history and scoreboards, custom mode item/rule fixes, Strikers 3-2-1 kickoff sync, RNNoise voice denoising, P2P relays, Linux Zink/Wayland compatibility, and Safe Mode polish.
Project KONGOR V cleanroom release with automated XWayland modesetting support, freedesktop 24.08 runtime, and AGPL-3.0-or-later alignment.
